name: OSS_EVENT_TYPE_CHARGES
description: Following table is used to capture event type charges.

columns.name: EVENT_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for used event type charges.

columns.name: EVENT_CHARGE_NAME
columns.description: Alternate key of usage event type charges.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture usage event type id.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture charge information.

columns.name: QTY_EVENT_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture quantity attribute.

columns.name: QTY_UOM_EVENT_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture quantity uom attribute.

columns.name: REPORTED_QTY_EVENT_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture reported quantity attribute.

columns.name: REPORTED_UOM_EVENT_ATTR_ID
columns.description: To specify the unit of measurement for the quantity of usage reported for a product or service.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This field tracks the source type of event type charges.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
